name: POST /api/dialer/dispatch - Dispatch the tenant's queued calls within its caps
description: Hands up to limit (1-500, default 50) of the tenant's due queued calls to the carrier, highest priority first. Each call must take a concurrency slot: a full campaign only holds back that campaign's calls, a full plan or key stops the drain. Dispatched calls become dialing (their contacts in_progress); held calls stay queued with last_reason capacity:<dimension>. Returns {dispatched: call_id[], blocked: {plan|key|campaign: n}, remaining}. A tenant never holds more concurrent calls (dialing, ringing, in progress) than min(plan cap, telephony-key capacity, campaign max_concurrency): the plan cap comes from the tenant plan (default DIALER_DEFAULT_PLAN_CONCURRENCY = 10), key capacity from the telephony credential of the agent’s published stack profile, the campaign cap from the campaign. Slots live in Redis sorted sets with a per-call lease (atomic Lua check-and-take), falling back to an exact Postgres count under a per-tenant advisory lock when Redis is unavailable; a call that ends frees its slot. The background fair-share scheduler runs the same step across tenants.

errorCases.message: limit must be an integer between 1 and 500
